metadata.name: Azure Update Manager Dashboard
metadata.description: Deploys a shared Azure Workbook and optionally an Azure Managed Grafana workspace backed by Change Tracking and Inventory data in Log Analytics.
The resource ID of the Log Analytics workspace that contains ConfigurationData records.
The Azure region in which to store the Workbook resource.
The display name shown for the Workbook in the Azure portal.
Whether to deploy a new Azure Managed Grafana workspace in this resource group.
The name of the Azure Managed Grafana workspace to deploy when shouldDeployManagedGrafana is true.
The SKU of the Azure Managed Grafana workspace.
Whether to allow public network access to a newly deployed Azure Managed Grafana workspace.
Whether to enable zone redundancy for a newly deployed Azure Managed Grafana workspace.
The object ID to receive Grafana Admin on a newly deployed workspace. No Grafana data-plane role is assigned when omitted.

The system-assigned managed identity principal ID of an existing Azure Managed Grafana workspace. When supplied without deploying a workspace, Monitoring Reader is assigned on the Log Analytics workspace.
